Phase 32 plan submitted: docs/phases/orchestration-controls-usage-surfacing-30-arc.md (brief: docs/tagteam-3.0-proposal.md §4 Phase 32, §8 Q4). Branch: phase-32-orchestration-controls (PR at the end).

Scope: `tagteam pause/resume/cancel-turn` (pause honored by ALL watcher modes; cancel kills the in-flight headless turn and the engine labels the outcome `cancelled` via a stem-matched marker), `tagteam interject` (additive `interjections` table with provenance — by/ts/phase/type/round/turn + delivered_role/round/stem/ts stamped only when the receiving headless turn is `ok`; injected as an ARBITER INTERJECTIONS block in the composed prompt; surfaced to interactive agents via an additive `interjections` list on `cycle rounds` output; rounds JSONL/table untouched), `tagteam usage` (per-turn lines + by-role/by-cycle/totals, `--json`, this project only), cross-platform `notify()` (osascript / PowerShell toast with `msg` fallback / notify-send; `TAGTEAM_NO_NOTIFY`; `watcher.notify_macos` kept as alias so existing patches work), Phase 31 follow-ups closed from data: `--turn-retries N` with a deterministic at-least-once rule (retry only spawn_failed/nonzero_exit/timeout AND `git status --porcelain` hash unchanged since pre-spawn; never no_round/cancelled), per-role `headless.timeout_minutes`, trimmed-contract question closed as "keep full" (contract ≈4–5K tokens vs 282K–1.69M per real reviewer turn, 91–96% cache-read). Optional `tagteam rollback X.Y.Z` (print-only unless --yes; detects uv-tool vs pip). Schema v4 additive (interjections table, `cancelled` status). Release 0.9.0.

Four open questions with recommendations: resume auto re-dispatch once; `--to lead|reviewer` targeting for interjections; toast-then-msg on Windows accepted as best-effort; keep rollback in.

Dogfood: THIS plan cycle's reviewer turns run headless (closes Phase 31 finding 9(b)); impl cycle exercises pause/interject/usage on this repo and cancel-turn on a scratch turn. Please review against docs/checklists/plan_review.md.

The plan is well structured and aligned with Phase 32, but three blocking changes are needed before implementation.

1. Make the retry gate safe with respect to both repository and handoff state. Hashing only `git status --porcelain` is insufficient: a turn can successfully run `cycle add` in DB-backed storage (handoff-state.json and .tagteam are ignored), then exit nonzero, and the proposed loop would retry the already-completed owed turn. A commit can also change HEAD while leaving status clean, and the default status output can collapse an untracked directory so edits beneath it do not change the hash. Snapshot and compare the expected cycle/state identity (at minimum state seq plus target cycle entry/status), and never retry after any handoff transition. The repository fingerprint should include HEAD plus `git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all`. Add tests for: nonzero after a successful cycle write (no retry), commit-then-fail (no retry), and mutation inside an already-untracked directory (no retry). Keep `no_round` and `cancelled` non-retryable as planned.

2. Specify stale-inflight safety for `cancel-turn`. Reading a leftover inflight.json and calling a public `kill_pid_tree(pid)` can kill an unrelated process after PID reuse, especially after a watcher crash. Define process-identity/liveness validation before signaling (implementation choice, but it must bind the PID to the recorded watcher/turn), reject missing/self/watcher/unrelated PIDs, and clean or report stale metadata without killing. Add an acceptance test whose stale inflight file points at an unrelated sleeper and proves it remains alive; retain the live child/grandchild kill test.

3. Resolve the interjection API in the normative plan. I accept the recommendation to ship `--to lead|reviewer`, defaulting to the next role, but `target_role` currently appears only in Open Question 2 and is absent from the in-scope command, schema, DB accessors, files, and success criteria. Add the column and validation, define pending selection as untargeted-or-matching the receiving role, and ensure delivery stamps exactly the IDs included in that prompt (not all currently pending rows). Cover a targeted note waiting across the other role's successful turn, then being delivered and stamped on its target role's turn. Also define `interject` behavior when there is no active owed cycle.

The other recommendations are accepted: resume auto-redispatches exactly once, Windows notification remains best-effort toast then msg fallback, and the small rollback command stays in scope. Please fold all four decisions into the normative Scope/Technical Approach/Schema/Success Criteria so implementation does not depend on an unresolved Open Questions section.

Round 2: all three blocking items folded into the normative Scope / Technical Approach / Schema / Success Criteria; the Open Questions section is now "None blocking" with a Decisions list (your four accepted recommendations + the two new rulings).

1. Retry gate — now gated on BOTH fingerprints, snapshotted pre-spawn: repo = sha1(`git rev-parse HEAD` ‖ `git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all`) (HEAD catches commit-then-fail; untracked-files=all catches edits under an already-untracked dir), and handoff = (state.seq, target cycle entry count, cycle state/ready_for/round). Retry only if outcome ∈ {spawn_failed, nonzero_exit, timeout} AND both unchanged; any handoff transition ⇒ never retry; no_round/cancelled never retried; non-git ⇒ only spawn_failed (handoff fingerprint still checked). Criteria/tests enumerate: nonzero after a successful cycle add → no retry; commit-then-fail → no retry; mutation inside an already-untracked directory → no retry; tracked edit → no retry; clean nonzero → retried.

2. cancel-turn stale-inflight safety — inflight.json now records `watcher_pid` (engine's os.getpid()) and `started_at`. Before signalling: reject pid missing / == self / == watcher_pid; reject not-alive; require parent_pid(pid) == watcher_pid (POSIX `ps -o ppid=`, Windows Get-CimInstance; lookup failure ⇒ unverifiable ⇒ do NOT kill); additionally reject start_time < started_at where cheap. On rejection: print reason, remove the stale inflight.json (metadata only, nothing signalled), exit 1. New small `tagteam/procs.py` (pid_alive/parent_pid/process_start_time). Acceptance test: hand-written inflight pointing at an unrelated sleeper (parent ≠ recorded watcher_pid) → sleeper stays alive, file cleaned, exit 1; plus self/watcher/missing/dead/unverifiable cases; the live child+grandchild kill test retained.

3. Interjection API — `--to lead|reviewer` is now in the in-scope command, schema (`target_role TEXT CHECK (NULL or lead|reviewer)`), accessors (`add_interjection(..., target_role)`, `pending_interjections_for(role)` = undelivered AND (target_role IS NULL OR = role), `mark_interjections_delivered(ids, …)` exact ids), files, prompt block (shows target), delivery rule (engine retains the exact rendered ids and stamps only those on `ok`; mid-turn or other-role notes stay pending), and success criteria (a `--to reviewer` note written before a lead turn is absent from the lead prompt and undelivered after the lead's ok, then present + stamped on the reviewer's ok). No active owed cycle: note stored (phase/type/round from state if any, turn NULL) with a warning "delivered to the next turn that starts".

Decisions recorded: resume auto-redispatches exactly once; toast then msg best-effort; rollback stays in scope (print-only unless --yes).
